steps.en: Install the desktop app with the one-line installer (macOS/Linux) or a release download
steps.zh: 用一行安装脚本或发布包装好桌面应用

steps.en: Sets up the Python backend, detects CUDA/MPS/CPU and downloads the default OmniVoice model when you accept
steps.zh: 搭好 Python 后端、识别显卡，经你同意下载默认 OmniVoice 模型

steps.en: Open Voice cloning, add a clean 5–15 s reference recording, type your text and generate
steps.zh: 打开声音克隆，放一段 5 到 15 秒的干净参考录音，输入文字并生成

steps.en: Transcribes the reference clip once and saves the transcript on the voice profile
steps.zh: 把参考录音转写一次，转写稿存进该音色档案

steps.en: Synthesizes the text chunk by chunk in that voice and adds an inaudible AI watermark
steps.zh: 按段用该音色合成整段文字，并加上听不见的 AI 水印

component.zh: 本地 FastAPI 后端（3900 端口）

value.en: Speech in a cloned voice generated on your own hardware — no per-character bill and no voice samples uploaded to a cloud
value.zh: 在自己机器上用克隆音色生成语音——不按字计费，也不用把声音样本传上云

sources: https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio README (Get started: curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh; 'Open Voice cloning, choose a voice or add a clean reference recording, enter your text, and generate. Install the required model when prompted.')
https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio docs/install/macos.md (first-run setup syncs deps and downloads model weights ~2.4 GB)
https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio docs/engines/README.md (Voice Clone recommends 5-15 s clean speech; OmniVoice best_window transcription; device auto-detect CUDA/ROCm/MPS/CPU)
https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio docs/performance.md (auto-transcription saved onto the profile; long texts split into chunks; post-process mastering + watermark)
https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio pyproject.toml (audioseal watermark, whisperx, fastapi) and docs/speech-platform.md (backend on :3900)
